title: Implement ELB-aware PPPF bias reductions and rerun NK ablations
description: Follow-up scientific work after the manuscript refactor: add better ELB regime mixtures, adaptive anchors/horizons, richer anticipated-shock proxies, and rerun the NK bias-attribution suite.
notes: Implemented quantile-clustered anchor caching in the RBPF and promoted clustered anchors to the PPPF benchmark baseline. Reduced NK likelihood gaps improved materially, but the direct simulated PPPF IRF remains unstable, so the remaining work is transition-level rather than anchor bookkeeping alone; keep dt2.1 open for the IRF/localized-transition follow-up.

title: Implement multi-anchor ELB-localized PPPF transition for NK IRFs
description: Deep-dive finding: after fixing omega-node decoding and shocked-anchor regime selection, the direct simulated PPPF IRF still explodes near the ELB under the shared-anchor transition. CE (K=1) and especially per-particle anchors reduce likelihood bias, which points to the shared-anchor local kernel as the remaining failure mode. Follow-up work should implement and benchmark a localized/multi-anchor transition that partitions particles by ELB proximity or regime risk, caches a small number of local mixtures, and re-runs the direct-kernel IRF plus NK ablations.

title: Replace PPPF Gaussian innovation closure near the ELB
description: Deep-dive result after clustered and per-particle anchors: the direct simulated PPPF IRF remains essentially unchanged and still explodes near the ELB even when anchor sharing is removed. This isolates the remaining failure to the one-step Gaussian innovation closure (the local Q implied by shock derivatives / current-shock Gaussianization), not to shared-anchor regime selection. Follow-up work should test discrete shock mixtures or localized innovation closures that preserve the conditional expectation map without injecting a destabilizing Gaussian tail across the kink.

title: Code+Paper: NK no-ELB sanity case where all methods coincide
description: Add a NK benchmark configuration where the ELB never binds (e.g. set i_lower very negative / remove max) so the model is effectively linear. Generate data from a common truth model and show: global discrete exact, PLC(interp)+PF, OccBin+PF, PPPF-RBPF all match loglik within tolerance and IRFs overlap. Wire into nk_compare outputs + add a short subsection/figure/table in the paper documenting the agreement as a calibration/sanity check.

title: Code: NK PPPF with anticipated-shock path (omega)
description: Implement PPPF as described in the paper: build reference paths conditional on an anticipated-shock object omega_t (short horizon of future innovations), compute pathwise Jacobians, and integrate omega via a nonnegative-weight quadrature/MC mixture. Update nk_elb.hpp + nk_compare.cpp to use the new transition and rerun experiments.
